title: Bariatric Endoscopy for Treatment of Obesity
official: Endoscopic Gastroplasty for Treatment of Obesity: a Single Centre, Randomized Trial
summary: A single-center, randomized trial will be conducted in order to compare three Endoscopic Gastroplasty (EG) techniques in obese patients (BMI 30-44.99 kg/m2) at Gastroenterology and Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Unit, Mater Olbia Hospital, Qatar Foundation Endowment \& Gemelli Foundation, Italy in period June 2020 - August 2024, with the aim to compare the efficacy and safety of these procedures.
